fallacies.name: Straw man
fallacies.explanation: S1 distorts Kuhn's paradigm account as mere social consensus replacing objective truth, ignoring the anomaly and puzzle-solving structure S2 described. Reducing paradigm shifts to mob rule attacks an exaggerated version, not Kuhn's actual position.
fallacies.quote: he just just substitutes the objective truth of a theory theory for the mere social consensus of a scientific community
